Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/whats-new
Fetched: 2026-05-18

# What's new in Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry Models (classic)

## May 2026

### GPT Realtime Translate and GPT Realtime Whisper
- GPT Realtime Translate — continuous stream-based audio translation for live multilingual events, customer support, voice assistants.
- GPT Realtime Whisper — low-latency streaming transcription for live captions, monitoring, archival workflows.

## February 2026

### GPT-Realtime-1.5 and GPT-Audio-1.5 models released
- Improvements in instruction following, multilingual support, and tool calling.
- Available via chat completion APIs.

## December 2025

### GPT-image-1.5 model available (limited access)
- Improved performance, quality, editing controls, face preservation.
- Inpainting; high quality up to 1024x1536 / 1536x1024; high input_fidelity editing.

### ASR model update — gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15
- ~50% lower WER vs prior model; improved Japanese/Indic multilingual; reduced hallucinations on silence (up to 4x).

### Realtime-mini speech-to-speech update — gpt-realtime-mini-2025-12-15
- Feature parity with full gpt-realtime in instruction-following and function-calling.

### Text-to-speech update — gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15
- New benchmark for multilingual speech synthesis; more natural human-like speech.

## October 2025

- Realtime API support for SIP — telephony connections to realtimeapi.
- GPT-4o audio model — gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize ASR with speaker diarization, 100+ languages, /audio and /realtime APIs.
- GPT-image-1-mini — smaller version of gpt-image-1 for global deployments.
- PII detection content filter — built-in filter for personally identifiable information.

## September 2025

- GPT-5-codex available (limited access) — designed for use with the Codex CLI and the VS Code Codex extension.
- Sora video-to-video support — short input video to generate longer video.

## August 2025

- Sora image-to-video support — Sweden Central, East US 2.
- Realtime API audio model GA — improved instruction following, new voices Marin and Cedar, image input, improved function calling (async), conversation mode (turn-taking with VAD).
- Provisioned spillover GA.
- GPT-5 models available — gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-chat; gpt-5 available for PTU (registration required for gpt-5/gpt-5-codex).
- New version of model-router — supports GPT-5 series models.

## July 2025

- GPT-image-1 (preview) update — input_fidelity parameter; partial image streaming.

## June 2025

- codex-mini and o3-pro models released.

## May 2025

- Sora (2025-05-02) video generation (preview).
- Spotlighting for prompt shields (preview) — tags input documents with special formatting for lower trust.
- Model router (preview) — deployable AI chat model that auto-selects best underlying chat model.

## April 2025

- Realtime API (preview) support for WebRTC.
- GPT-image-1 released (preview, limited access).
- o4-mini and o3 reasoning models released.
- GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1-nano released — 1M token context.
- gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe (STT), gpt-4o-mini-tts (TTS) audio models.

## March 2025

- Responses API — new stateful API combining chat completions and assistants.
- computer-use-preview model — powers Computer use capability (registration required).
- Provisioned spillover (preview).
- Specify content filtering configurations at request time.

## February 2025

- GPT-4.5 Preview.
- Stored completions API.
- o3-mini data zone standard deployments.
- gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview and gpt-4o-mini-realtime-preview.

## January 2025

- o3-mini released.
- GPT-4o audio completions — gpt-4o-audio-preview global deployments East US 2, Sweden Central.
- GPT Realtime API 2024-12-17 — prompt caching support, new voices (alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, sage, shimmer, verse), RPM/TPM rate limiting.

## December 2024

- o1 reasoning model (limited access).
- Preference fine-tuning DPO (preview).
- Stored completions & distillation.
- GPT-4o 2024-11-20 global standard deployment.
- Data zone provisioned deployment type.

Updated: 2026-05-18
